dialogues.speaker: Parmenides
dialogues.text: Your footsteps carry a sticky sound. You've just come from the "outside," haven't you?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: "Outside"? You mean outside the Temple of Space?

dialogues.speaker: Parmenides
dialogues.text: Or rather, the illusory world of the senses. Everything there is far too unstable: The sky changes color, nations rise and fall, even memories fade away.

dialogues.speaker: Parmenides
dialogues.text: That is why I'm so grateful to be here, a paradise in eternal stillness.

dialogues.speaker: Parmenides
dialogues.text: Unfortunately, thanks to those fellows who love creating new things, even this place has become unsafe lately. That's why I'm forced to hide in this corner of the "Mahavaipulya Chamber."

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Sorry, I think I've taken a wrong turn...

dialogues.speaker: Parmenides
dialogues.text: It's alright. Just try to keep the noise down when you leave.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Don't you want to go out and have a look?

dialogues.speaker: Parmenides
dialogues.text: Hmm? I assume it's Mengzhou who sent you here to persuade me. That nihilist is the very incarnation of this illusory world. I suggest you speak with him as little as possible.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: It's not that scary out there.

dialogues.speaker: Parmenides
dialogues.text: Perhaps. But if you truly understood the eternal being, you would lose all interest in a world of ceaseless flux.
